title: Tel Aviv — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Tel Aviv: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Tel Aviv has a population of 460,000. Israel’s vibrant economic and tech hub on the Mediterranean coast, known for its startup scene, beaches, and nightlife. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
